summary: Reviewed strict input boundaries, retained-source identity, immutable candidate lineage, independent inventory and authenticated issue decisions against E01-E04 before the focused phase run.
findings: Persisted records use byte-identical packaged monograph schemas; policy validation adds finite ceilings and rejects paid providers and weakened mandatory checks.

Source units are an independently supplied inventory, not claimed automatically exhaustive. Retained units must resolve exact imported source spans. A changed source requires an authenticated explicit invalidation.
All alternatives remain immutable. Caps retain the omitted proposal and create SEARCH_INCOMPLETE. No confidence probability is assigned.
Issue decisions bind revision and candidate identity and cannot vote away absent dependencies or structural checks. Child roots inherit their parent's budget identity.
Early bundle associations are persisted now; enforcement in the existing release service is a P3 prerequisite, so P1 alone is not release-ready.
The master tests exercise predecessor, stale review, counted interruption and repair-budget refusal; no test pass substitutes for legal accuracy.
